You don’t have to love powerlooms or hate hand weaving to recognize a powerloom when you see one. Lots of intellectual tasks that used to be pure craft & which, therefore, could never be industrialized might soon be subject to the logic of industrialization. Not an easy change.
We should spend more effort thinking about how to preserve craft and augment it, automation is seductive but not an inevitable path.
